local holyshit;
for _, func in getgc() do -- getgc() returns list of garbage collection values
    if typeof(func) == "function" --[[checks if func is function]] and debug.info(func, "s"):find("NovyHraac") then  -- debug.info(thread or function, level :string)
    -- "s" is function source (full name of script where defined our function)
        local line = debug.info(func, "l") -- line where defined our function
        if line == 34 then -- use konstant decompiler to find  
            holyshit = func -- save reference to found function so we can hook it later
        end
    end
end
